recognize_zh: 心包膜纖維組織表面與內部有密集、單一型的小型淋巴球浸潤，高倍插圖為成片的小圓核淋巴球，兩種免疫染色皆呈瀰漫陽性，符合慢性淋巴球性白血病／小淋巴球性淋巴瘤侵犯心包膜。
features: Low power (A): pericardial fibrous tissue with a dense band-like and nodular lymphoid infiltrate along the surface and extending into the wall
Inset: sheets of monotonous small lymphocytes with round dark nuclei and scant cytoplasm
No large transformed cells or distinct proliferation centers identifiable at this magnification
IHC (B): diffuse strong staining of the lymphoid infiltrate (marker unlabeled)
IHC (C): diffuse, somewhat weaker staining of the same population (marker unlabeled; compatible with co-expression such as CD5 or CD23)
describe_en: Sections of pericardium show fibrous tissue with a dense infiltrate of lymphoid cells along the surface and within the wall. At higher magnification the infiltrate consists of sheets of monotonous small lymphocytes with round nuclei, condensed chromatin and scant cytoplasm; large cells or proliferation centers are not evident at this magnification. Two immunohistochemical stains (not labeled in the figure) diffusely highlight the infiltrate. In the appropriate immunophenotypic context (CD20 weak, CD5+, CD23+, LEF1+), findings are consistent with pericardial involvement by chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Reactive pericarditis has a mixed infiltrate of lymphocytes, plasma cells and histiocytes with fibrin, rather than monotonous sheets of B cells co-expressing CD5 and CD23.
MCL cells have irregular notched nuclei and are cyclin D1/SOX11 positive and CD23 negative.
MZL shows monocytoid cells with pale cytoplasm and plasmacytic differentiation and is CD5 and CD23 negative.
Richter transformation shows sheets of large cells with vesicular nuclei and high Ki-67, not small mature lymphocytes.

captions: H&E: dense small lymphocytic infiltrate in pericardium (inset: monotonous small lymphocytes)
IHC: diffuse staining of the lymphoid infiltrate
IHC: diffuse staining with a second marker
